content: Intel recorded net restructuring charges of **$2.2 billion in 2025** that were primarily associated with the initiation and deployment of the 2025 Restructuring Plan. These charges consisted of $1.8 billion in cash‑based employee severance and related exit costs and $474 million in non‑cash asset impairment charges related to the exit of certain non‑core lines of business and real‑estate consolidation.【Doc 1】
